name: Nanobots3
title: Nanobots: Early Bots 3.0
author: Nexela (original), AI-improved
description: Personal construction nanobots for Factorio 2.1: build, repair, upgrade, and supply turret ammunition without a roboport network. Features quality support, vehicle and cargo-wagon materials, remote-view construction, Nano/Thermite switching, combat automation, and statistics. Space Age compatible. The maintained branch is 5.9.x; legacy 5.8.x releases are no longer maintained.
